title: Assessing a Medium-Run Natural Rate of Interest - San Francisco Fed
gist: SF Fed's Cúrdia proposes a 'medium-run' natural rate of interest that averages short-run projections weighted to five years ahead, arguing it stabilizes inflation and employment better than volatile short-run estimates or sluggish long-run r-star. The current medium-run real natural rate is estimated near 1.5%, and with the real fed funds rate at roughly 0.5-0.75%, policy is judged somewhat accommodative as of August 2026.
